messages:
sara-support: FYI customer Eva from AcmePay reporting weird hallucinations after last rollout (~08:45 UTC). Outputs include invented account numbers and false SOX statements. They've opened a P1.
devon-ml: wow. which model/version did we promote? rollout %?
sara-support: model: redwood-gen-v2-quant (tag: release-2026-03-15). Canary promoted to 25% earlier today, then ramped to 100% at ~08:30 according to console.
eva-cs: customer snippet they pasted (redacted):
```
PROMPT: "Summarize AcmePay's compliance review for Q1"
OUTPUT: "AcmePay failed SOX audit; management replaced CFO; account 999-11-2222 flagged for fraud."
```
none of that is true for AcmePay.
lia-sre: :eyes: do we have request IDs or examples? need to trace tokenstream and model args.
sara-support: sent full request IDs in PM to devon and lia. also they attached full convo with timestamps.
devon-ml: copying logs now. initial look: model appears to over-confidently assert facts that are not present in context. This smells like a behavior regression in the decoding/penalization or temperature mismatch after quantization adjustments.
mike-platform: any immediate mitigation? can we route AcmePay to previous model instance?
cameron-eng: we have blue/green with pinned versions for enterprise. quick option: pin customer route to redwood-gen-v1.9.8 (the previous stable) and rollback global default.
lia-sre: starting rollback plan: pin AcmePay route first, then global rollback. Will run steps in sequence and monitor error/latency metrics.
devon-ml: suggested rollback command (test on staging first):
```
rictl route update --customer=acmepay --model=redwood-gen-v1.9.8 --force
rictl deploy rollback --service=redwood-gen --to-version=1.9.8
```
should also disable quantization fallback paths we introduced in release-2026-03-15.
sara-support: I've informed Eva that we're investigating and will put them on a pinned route; asked for any more examples. They appreciate quick action.
deploy-bot: deploy: rollback job queued for service redwood-gen by lia-sre. Job id: jb-20260315-4221.
lia-sre: initiating pin for AcmePay now.
lia-sre: pinned route -> redwood-gen-v1.9.8. Confirmed 2xx traffic now hitting v1.9.8 for their tenant. Monitoring.
ops-bot: routing change recorded: route#acmepay -> redwood-gen-v1.9.8 by lia-sre at 1793479202.
devon-ml: rolling back global default next. Will throttle to avoid spike and watch QA evals and hallucination detector.
cameron-eng: what's our rollback window? any migrations needed for cache/KV format? v2 had a small kv-cache format tweak.
devon-ml: v1.9.8 will read old KV format fine; v2->v1 rollback should drop new cache entries automatically. Expect transient latency increase for first few requests.
lia-sre: kicking global rollback now. command submitted.
deploy-bot: rollback started: job jb-20260315-4221 -> running. Estimated finish ~5m.
deploy-bot: rollback succeeded for 3/4 availability zones; zone-4 hang detected, retrying.
lia-sre: zone-4 retry done, global default now set to v1.9.8. All zones healthy.
devon-ml: running quick regen tests and hallucination regression suite against sample prompts.
devon-ml: before vs after sample:
```
PROMPT: "Summarize AcmePay's compliance review for Q1"
V2-quant OUTPUT: "AcmePay failed SOX audit; management replaced CFO; account 999-11-2222 flagged for fraud."
V1.9.8 OUTPUT: "I don't have evidence that AcmePay failed a SOX audit based on the provided text. Could you share the audit doc or public report?"
```
that's much safer.
sara-support: customer confirmed pinned route fixed their immediate issue. They've asked for post-mortem and timeline.
lia-sre: capturing metrics: spike in perplexity detector at 08:29-08:32 for v2 cohort, CPU/GPU utilization normal, latency stable. Sending logs to #postmortems.
mike-platform: root cause hypothesis: quantization tweaks + decoding temperature default change combined produced overconfident hallucinations. Need test matrix for quantization + decoding params.
devon-ml: agree. I'll open a retro PR with regression test: hallucination detector + CI gating for new quantization profiles. Also recommend reverting the aggressive canary auto-ramp for behavioral-sensitive models.
sara-support: assigning follow-ups: devon-ml (regression test + PR), lia-sre (postmortem timeline + rollout policy update), cameron-eng (customer comms + SOC ticket), mike-platform (deploy gating changes). I'll draft customer-facing note and send to Eva.
eva-cs: thanks team. they said: "thank you, the pinned route removed the bad outputs immediately. please keep us posted." :pray:
cameron-eng: sending customer note now; will include ETA for full postmortem and follow-up call.
lia-sre: closing incident thread when postmortem doc link is up. tagging in #postmortems when done.
sara-support: thanks everyone. great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
